name: Midpage Legal Research
description: Connect Claude to a database of case law. With the Midpage MCP, Claude can conduct complex legal research, review opinions, and craft high quality work product. Everything is hyperlinked to real sources for easy verification.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Midpage Legal Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Midpage Legal Research to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.midpage.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Midpage Legal Research MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Midpage Legal Research provides these MCP tools: search, findInOpinion, and analyzeOpinion.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Midpage Legal Research?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Midpage Legal Research in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, common-practice, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, and Lyon.

_published_faq.name: Does Midpage Legal Research MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Midpage Legal Research requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Midpage Legal Research is developed by Midpage. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
